rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design consolidates the 54-file / 17-null-site / 23-region machinery into four single-entry modules (topology.py `read`, current.py `book`, gs.py `apply`, solve.py `fixed_point`), each hiding substantial behaviour (fragment/membership read with null census and normal-form saddle support; clipped-fragment booking; the map with its implicit-Picard, moment-map and boundary-flux derivative bundle; Newton-GMRES on the map's own JVP with a line search) behind one function signature — surface shrinks, depth increases, and the split is by stage of one pipeline rather than wrappers over the same call.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — every recurring duplicate is bound to a named owner rather than forked: path/receipt placement to nova/database/filepath.py (FilePath); compile-program counting to scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py ("No node builds a second compilation counter"); constraint-row scale/tolerance to nova/equilibrium/constraint.py (ConstraintPair/ConstraintRecord, "no second declaration of a row scale exists in solve.py"); polygon moments to nova/equilibrium/polygon_moments.py ("after retirement polygon_moments.py is the only module under nova that integrates a monomial over a polygon"); null evaluation to nova/biot/null.py + fieldnull.py; the fixed-point kernel to be moved before §6 deletes fixed_point.py. I found no mechanism the plan re-implements while an owner exists untouched.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0: no section adds net surface to any of these four families. §2 extends `ForwardSolvePolicy` in place (TopologyPolicy already at nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py:233,327); §3/§4/§5 add three module functions but each section names in its own text what it retires (`clipped_support_current_moments`; the `ForwardFluxOperator` map; `newton_krylov`/`picard`/`operator_request_body`), and §6 states the retirement list (promotion/recovery rungs, frozen/live split, live-read fallback, active-set/anderson/reduced-Newton/chord routes, `fixed_point.py`, `reduced_newton.py`, and the solver+booking authority in `forward_operator.py`). Every section either names a retirement or is a pure prose/inventory section, so nothing adds surface unaccounted for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every proposed mechanism names the existing mechanism it replaces or reuses, and the citations resolve: `topology.read` cites `Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity`/`read_qualification`/`split_flux_map` in nova/equilibrium/topology.py and reuses `build_contour_tree` from nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py (the landed read calls it at topology.py:2907); `current.book` cites `clipped_support_current_moments` in nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py:714 plus a recorded moment-owner ruling naming nova/equilibrium/polygon_moments.py as the single polygon-moment owner; `gs.apply` cites the `ForwardFluxOperator` map and the `_flatten_*`/`_SourceLayout`/`_OperatorPytreeAux` operand machinery in nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:147-227,2079-2260,2323; `solve.fixed_point` cites `newton_krylov`/`picard`/`operator_request_body` and the `_single_site_krylov` kernel in nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:972,2619; layout/path/compile-count owners are cited (nova/database/filepath.py FilePath+repository_relative, scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py, nova/equilibrium/constraint.py ConstraintPair/ConstraintRecord, nova/equilibrium/coefficient_carrier.py) and each was confirmed present.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no new module is a thin layer over machinery it could extend: §4 states `gs.apply` "replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs today rather than wrapping it"; §5 states `solve.fixed_point` "replaces newton_krylov, picard and the request body operator_request_body" and keeps only the single-site pattern as a private helper; §2 replaces the read in place in topology.py; §3 carries the clip-quadrature helpers as private helpers behind the one booking call site. Each substitution states why the owner is replaced.
